trial_title: Safety Study of Carotid Body Neurostimulation to Treat Cerebral Vasospasm
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and performance of the Delta system in the treatment of cerebral vasospasm post aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage (aSAH) patients.
